title: When Entitlement Backfires: Mom Challenges Officer, Faces Unavoidable Justice!
description:
On January 9th, 2023, an SRO in Oklahoma was alerted to a mother using profanity and arguing in the front office. Despite the mother being warned about her behavior, she continued to argue and become increasingly loud and rude to both staff and the SRO in the office. The situation intensified when the mother attempted to leave the office while being spoken to. 

As the SRO intervened and instructed the mother to put her hands behind her back, she refused and continued to walk away. A physical struggle ensued as the officer attempted to handcuff the suspect, as she resisted arrest. Despite the officer's efforts to de-escalate, the suspect remained uncooperative, refusing to enter the patrol car. After being placed in handcuffs and placed in a patrol car, the suspect continued to argue and yell at officers, asking why she had been arrested. 

The suspect was charged with Disorderly Conduct and Resisting Arrest.
